translated_text: Perintah Linux find /var/log -type f -mtime +30 menemukan file log lama.

original_text: Linux kill -9 PID command forcefully terminates stuck background process.
translated_text: Perintah Linux kill -9 PID menghentikan proses latar belakang yang macet secara paksa.

original_text: Linux ps aux command lists all active running system processes.
translated_text: Perintah Linux ps aux mendaftarkan semua proses sistem yang sedang berjalan.

original_text: Linux uptime command displays system running duration and load averages.
translated_text: Perintah Linux uptime menampilkan durasi berjalan sistem dan rata-rata beban.

original_text: Linux lscpu command displays CPU architecture hardware specifications.
translated_text: Perintah Linux lscpu menampilkan spesifikasi perangkat keras arsitektur CPU.

original_text: Linux lsblk command lists block storage devices and disk partitions.
translated_text: Perintah Linux lsblk mendaftarkan perangkat penyimpanan block dan partisi disk.

original_text: Linux vmstat 1 command prints virtual memory statistics every second.
translated_text: Perintah Linux vmstat 1 mencetak statistik memori virtual setiap detik.

original_text: Linux sar -u 1 10 command monitors CPU load statistics over time.
translated_text: Perintah Linux sar -u 1 10 memantau statistik beban CPU dari waktu ke waktu.

original_text: Linux tcpdump -i eth0 port 80 command captures HTTP network packets.
translated_text: Perintah Linux tcpdump -i eth0 port 80 menangkap paket jaringan HTTP.

original_text: Linux traceroute command traces network packet hop routing path.
translated_text: Perintah Linux traceroute melacak jalur rute hop paket jaringan.

original_text: Linux ping -c 4 command tests network ICMP latency to host IP.
translated_text: Perintah Linux ping -c 4 mengetes latensi ICMP jaringan ke IP host.

original_text: Linux rsync -avz command syncs files securely over SSH connection.
translated_text: Perintah Linux rsync -avz mensinkronkan file secara aman melalui koneksi SSH.

original_text: Linux crontab -e command edits user scheduled background cron jobs.
translated_text: Perintah Linux crontab -e menyunting cron job latar belakang terjadwal pengguna.

original_text: Linux environment variable exported using export VAR=value in bashrc.
translated_text: Variabel lingkungan Linux diekspor menggunakan export VAR=value di bashrc.

original_text: Linux alias command creates custom command line shortcut alias.
translated_text: Perintah alias Linux membuat alias pintasan command line kustom.

original_text: Linux history command lists executed terminal command history lines.
translated_text: Perintah history Linux mendaftarkan baris riwayat perintah terminal yang dieksekusi.

original_text: Linux head -n 20 command prints first 20 lines of log file.
translated_text: Perintah head -n 20 Linux mencetak 20 baris pertama file log.

original_text: Linux tail -n 50 -f command streams last 50 lines of live log file.
translated_text: Perintah tail -n 50 -f Linux mengaliri 50 baris terakhir file log langsung.
